points.note: Axis point = bright dome shaft-end at the center of the golden end disc gear, seen through the black pillow-block bearing upright (ch13 signature). Believed to be the nearer of the two parallel cylinder gears; the second is hidden behind it.

Upper/outer corner of the tip end face of the lowest, fully visible rocker arm (the one resting on the gray pivot-pin head). Tip face is nearly edge-on, so the two tip corners stack almost vertically.
Lower/inner corner of the same tip end face, at the kink where the tip edge meets the arm's long bottom edge.
Outer-top corner of the green clamp boss at the far-left end of the top frame casting (below its silver cap).
Outer-top rim of the near green corner boss of the top frame (the back-right corner, nearest the camera).
Outer-top corner of the green top-frame casting at the image-right end (front-right of the machine).
Bottom-left tip of the green base slab skirt at the far end of the long back edge.
Nearest bottom corner of the base slab: vertex where the back bottom edge meets the right-side bottom edge.
Outermost bottom corner at the image-right end of the slab, where the right-side bottom edge recedes to the front.

occluded.reason: The pinion sprocket + large brass drive gear sit at platen level on the FRONT face; from this back view they are hidden behind the platen board (only its black back and brass rack are visible).
Optional feature; the crank and its axle sprocket are on the front face, hidden behind the platen board.
Axis point not visible: the cone gear stack sits at the machine's center behind the green A-frame pedestal and the cylinder-gear cluster; no end face or shaft point resolvable.
Axis point not visible: the second cylinder gear is behind the first; only tooth glimpses appear above it, no end disc or shaft end resolvable.
Butt/pivot end of the marked arm is hidden behind the chain-anchor keyhole boss, the A-frame apex and the stack of neighboring arms.
Same occlusion as butt_left: the wide pivot end disappears into the stacked fan at the central column.
Far top corner hidden behind the central spring stack and summing-lever hardware.
Far bottom corner hidden behind the black base floor plate and the gear cluster mounted on it.

orientation_note: Back-right three-quarter view (matches the book's 'eight views' angle-210 rendition). FRONT = platen/paper side, facing away from the camera; the platen's black back and brass rack fill the image-right half. Left/right are machine-relative (stage handedness: the machine's right = viewer's left when facing the front), so the nearest lower slab corner is base_back_right, the long visible bottom edge runs to back_left at image left, and the right-side edge recedes to front_right at image right. The counter-spring drum, chain and the visible cylinder-gear end disc are on the image-left/center.
